name: Taiwan Tea Corporation
summary: Taiwan Tea Corporation engages in the manufacturing and selling of tea and other agricultural products in Taiwan. The company operates in Retail and Trading, and Asset segments. It is also involved in trading of imported goods, including food, alcoholic beverages, and other products; and operation of recreational tourism. In addition, the company provides management of land assets, such as land inspections, land and building leases, and contract renewals. The company was formerly known as Mitsui & Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taiwan Tea Corporation in 1950. Taiwan Tea Corporation was founded in 1899 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
